verdict.rationale: Cursor is operated mainly through natural-language prompts. Its agent takes plain-language instructions from the terminal (`agent -p "Add comprehensive JSDoc comments..."`), from Slack via @cursor, from PR comments, and from the Cloud Agents API `prompt` field. The `/automate` skill even lets users describe a whole automation workflow in plain language, and Cursor configures its triggers, instructions and tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as documented (all evidence is first-party).
